verdict.rationale: Box ships a native e-signature product, Box Sign, and documents an API that brings the full Box Sign web app experience into applications. That API lets teams send documents for signature and track them through to a signed file, so signing happens where the content lives. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and detailed evidence on how signed files are stored back in Box folders and on signer workflow depth (templates, multi-signer routing).

support.subject: As an operations lead, signatures happen where the files live — a native e-signature product or documented first-party signing integration

citations.quote: Box Sign brings the full Box Sign web app experience to your application through the API.
